hits.snippet: OMAHA, Neb., May 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Exodus Movement, Inc. (NYSE American: EXOD) ("Exodus"), a leading self-custodial cryptocurrency platform, today announced that it has acquired the outstanding shares of Baanx US Corp. and certain other assets from W3C Corp.
